key_insight: Probabilistic error cancellation can be combined with GKP error correction, but the mitigation cost depends strongly on the code geometry, decoding method, and finite-squeezing noise.
engineering_relevance: This work informs how to trade off hardware noise, ancilla quality, and sampling overhead when designing practical continuous-variable quantum processors.
method: Compare Steane-type vs teleportation-based GKP error correction
Use stabilizer subsystem decomposition to derive effective logical channels
Compute sampling overheads for square and hexagonal GKP codes under finite squeezing
evidence_signal: The abstract reports calculated sampling overheads for single- and two-qubit GKP Clifford gates plus one round of error correction, evaluated under finite squeezing on data and ancilla modes.
watch_item: The approach is sensitive to finite squeezing and decoding choice, so overheads may become impractical if ancilla noise is too large or if the chosen code geometry is suboptimal.
paper_title: Probabilistic Error Cancellation for Single-Mode Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Codes
